en: Commemorating the release of the theatrical version! 1/72 VF-25F Messiah Valkyrie Alto machine with shining silver mirage coating!
●1/72 Scale Assembly type plastic model (no adhesive required)
●The kit body has a special coating finish that resembles metal.
-Complete transformation into Battroid form, Gawar form, and Fighter form
-Metallic decal included (water slide type that is easy to apply to surfaces, silk printing that is difficult to see through)
